label: Compass Rose
description: A compass-rose graphic that can rotate to a bound Heading (degrees) -- or sits static as decorative chrome if left unbound.
lua_draw_body:
local cx, cy, rad = {cx}, {cy}, {radius}
 local heading = tonumber({heading}) or 0
 local r, g, b = {color}
 local ar, ag, ab = {accent_color}
 cairo_save(cr)
 cairo_translate(cr, cx, cy)
 cairo_rotate(cr, math.rad(heading))
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity})
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, 1.5)
 cairo_new_sub_path(cr)
 cairo_arc(cr, 0, 0, rad, 0, 2 * math.pi)
 cairo_stroke(cr)
 for i = 0, 3 do
 local ang = math.rad(i * 90)
 if i == 0 then cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, {opacity})
 else cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity}) end
 cairo_move_to(cr, 0, 0)
 cairo_line_to(cr, math.cos(ang) * rad * 0.9, math.sin(ang) * rad * 0.9)
 cairo_line_to(cr, math.cos(ang + 0.06) * rad * 0.2, math.sin(ang + 0.06) * rad * 0.2)
 cairo_close_path(cr)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 cairo_move_to(cr, 0, 0)
 cairo_line_to(cr, math.cos(ang - 0.06) * rad * 0.2, math.sin(ang - 0.06) * rad * 0.2)
 cairo_line_to(cr, math.cos(ang) * rad * 0.9, math.sin(ang) * rad * 0.9)
 cairo_close_path(cr)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 end
 if {show_labels} then
 local labels = {'N', 'E', 'S', 'W'}
 cairo_select_font_face(cr, 'Sans', CAIRO_FONT_SLANT_NORMAL, CAIRO_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD)
 cairo_set_font_size(cr, math.max(8, rad * 0.14))
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, 1, 1, 1, {opacity})
 for i = 0, 3 do
 local ang = math.rad(i * 90 - 90)
 local lx = math.cos(ang) * rad * 1.12
 local ly = math.sin(ang) * rad * 1.12
 local lab = labels[i + 1]
 local ext = cairo_text_extents_t:create()
 cairo_text_extents(cr, lab, ext)
 cairo_move_to(cr, lx - ext.width / 2, ly + ext.height / 2)
 cairo_show_text(cr, lab)
 end
 end
 cairo_restore(cr)
